{{Otheruses|Virgillia}}
'''Virgillians''' were the residents of the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]] in the [[Koradin sector/Legends|Koradin sector]]. Virgillian society had a [[Noble/Legends|nobility]], which included the family of [[Rannd Delckis]]. The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] [[Monnda Tebbo]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member who was sent to Virgillia for several weeks, was one of the few non-Humans to fight in the [[Virgillian Civil War]] and was considered to be an honorary Virgillian citizen.
